conclusion: The direct wave32 and contiguous-group4 register-resident schedules produce large prefill gains but fail the frozen 18-prompt semantic gate; irregular group3 fails the predeclared speed floor. All temporary candidate kernels, registry entries, selectors, routing, and candidate tests were removed. Exact chain_lds32_direct remains the production route.
